crossRefs.note: She said to the servant, “Who is the man who is walking in the field to meet us?” The servant said, “It is my master.”…
She took off the garments of her widowhood, and covered herself with her veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the gate…
When Judah saw her, he thought that she was a prostitute, for she had covered her face.

people.name: Leah
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of six sons and Dinah

translations.web: In the evening, he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to Jacob. He went in to her.
translations.bsb: But when evening came, Laban took his daughter Leah and gave her to Jacob, and he slept with her.

translations.asv: And it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him. And he went in unto her.
